title: Sync and fulfillment resilience: data-integrity and retry-safety hardening

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every shipped transition persists its durable inventory-deduction intent in the same transaction, and forced rollback plus retry cannot leave shipped state without intent or create duplicate intent rows.
Fulfillment outbox success, shipment confirmation, and canonical order status reconverge atomically; a torn projection repairs once and the repeat pass is a no-op without another provider dispatch.

Shopify and direct label purchase use durable fail-closed intent, reject unsafe or cross-order operator proof, prevent a second purchase after an acknowledged-but-unpersisted result, and fence stale repeated resolution.
ShipStation confirmation retry re-reads upstream shipped truth and leaves the marketplace notification spy at one call after simulated local-settlement loss.

Inventory recovery remains ledger-idempotent and kill-switch governed; the bounded recent production dry-run reported 672 of 672 shipped lines and 881 of 881 units represented, with zero missing orders and no apply.

The nine production provider-pending health facts are safely classified read-only: all nine have durable provider receipts on active outbound shipments, across eight orders and three inactive jobs, and unresolved label-purchase-intent count is zero.
The focused PS-432 suite, all 45 mandatory source-of-truth guards, strict TypeScript checks, and production frontend build pass at the exact reviewed SHA.

Shipped/cancelled protections and the inventory kill switch are not weakened; closure performs no production write, label purchase or void, postage charge, marketplace notification, inventory movement, or automatic retry.

sotBypass.details: Inventory movement, purchase intent, confirmation settlement, provider notification idempotency, and shipped-state durability remain in named backend owners. Routes and callers pass intent and transaction context; the frontend owns none of these decisions.

evidence.proves: Real canonical owners execute against a current-schema PostgreSQL-compatible fixture: rollback removes both status and intent, retry commits one pair, concurrent duplicate intents retain one durable row, torn confirmation projections reconverge once, and repeat operations have no second effect.

A Shopify retry is blocked before a second purchase-spy call; cross-order shipment proof and no-label proof conflicting with an active shipment are rejected; a stale terminal resolver is rejected; and ShipStation retry keeps marketplace notifications at one.

Injected transaction failure, provider-ACK/local-persistence loss, torn succeeded projection, and confirmation-ACK/local-settlement loss recover without missing intent, duplicate purchase, duplicate notification, or stale overwrite.

evidence.command: Run docs/final-review/evidence/PS-432-provider-pending-readonly.sql in a production READ ONLY transaction and compare /health/deep.
evidence.proves: Production read-only classification reports nine stale sidecar facts, nine durable shipment/provider receipts, eight distinct orders, three inactive jobs, six queue entries, and zero unresolved purchase intents. No provider or write boundary was touched.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-433-rate-boundary (executed by npm run test:sot-guard-pack)
evidence.proves: The adjacent backend rate/label boundary rejects cross-order selected-rate keys, cross-account purchase identity, and mismatched request facts before the provider spy is touched, proving PS-432 did not weaken the broader label purchase boundary.

The recorded bounded production dry-run found no missing recent ledger lines/orders, while the tool defaults to dry-run and refuses unbounded --all --apply; the inventory kill switch and ledger idempotency owner remain intact.
The source-of-truth placement guard and executable failure, retry, concurrency, fencing, purchase, and notification proof run together at the reviewed SHA.

evidence.command: npm run test:sot-guard-pack with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: All 45 mandatory source-of-truth, worker, inventory, billing, rate/label, lockdown, and lifecycle guards pass at the exact reviewed SHA.
Backend and frontend strict TypeScript checks pass.
The production frontend bundle builds successfully with 2,989 modules transformed.

The implementation is limited to durable intent, atomic confirmation settlement, safe purchase/notification retry, guarded diagnostics, and offline/live-read-only evidence. The exact formally locked file touched was src/services/labels.ts for transactional shipped-state plus inventory-intent persistence and Shopify purchase recovery; required override comments and commit text are present, and protections were not weakened.
